correctness.rationale: Squaring (a,b) gives (a²+2b²,2ab); direct evaluation gives the twelve nonzero vectors on the three stated directions. Choose a linear basis taking those directions to horizontal, vertical and the positive diagonal. Any noncollinear triangle uses all three directions. For a horizontal edge from (0,0) to (a,0) with a≠0, the two common neighbors off the row are (0,−a) and (a,a), which are not adjacent; neither is adjacent to another point of that row. Thus every clique of size at least four is collinear, and the 50 horizontal edges account once each for two mixed triangles. The 15 five-point lines then give face vector (25,150,250,75,15). Distinct lines meet in at most one point; on each line simplex first remove the tetrahedron opposite a chosen vertex together with the simplex, then collapse the four remaining tetrahedra along their opposite triangles. This is a genuine reduction to a connected 2-complex of Euler characteristic 65. Independently of the supplied Tietze search, every clique-complex edge path is homotopic rel endpoints to horizontal and vertical unit steps: a diagonal displacement can be replaced by its horizontal-vertical detour using a triangle, and each line simplex permits replacing jumps by unit paths. The unit grid with each square split along the positive diagonal on R²/(5Z)² maps into the complex, and therefore surjects on fundamental groups. Its two generator loops lie in full row/column simplices, so both die. Hurewicz and homological Whitehead now give a wedge of 64 two-spheres. A nonidentity translation has vertex orbits of length five; its only setwise fixed simplices are the five parallel five-point line simplices when its direction is square. Each has positive orientation sign. Subtracting the H0 trace from the alternating chain trace gives 4 or −1; the identity gives 64. For a nontrivial additive character the sum s over the three square lines is 2 if its kernel is one of them, otherwise −3. Fourier inversion gives (13+s)/5 and trivial multiplicity 4, yielding the reported 4,3,2 classes of multiplicities.
residual_risks: The record concerns ordinary homotopy and a rational representation; neither an equivariant wedge nor an integral translation-module splitting follows. The frozen clique loop stops at size five; the independent clique argument excludes higher faces.
